QuestInfo.name: Mrs. Ming Ming's Salad Recipe
QuestInfo.1: Camila was supposed to get a salad recipe from Mrs. Ming Ming, but she promised poor, sick Maya that she would stay with her. She asked you to go to Mrs. Ming Ming and get the recipe instead.
QuestInfo.2: You met Mrs. Ming Ming, and explained why Camila couldn't come.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 420 Can proceed to the Green Mushroom Salad Recipe quest

0.0: #h0#! Guess what? Mrs. Ming Ming has a recipe for a brand new salad. She said I could come pick it up now, but I have to go visit Maya at the hospital. Could you go get it for me? I don't wanna keep Mrs. Ming Ming waiting.\r\n

yes.0: Hooray! Okay, Mrs. Ming Ming is Chief Stan's wife, and she keeps #m100000000#  tidy all on her own. Isn't that amazing? You'll find Mrs. Ming Ming in front of Chief Stan's house. His house is just up the stairs to the left. Can't miss it!

no.0: Really? Oh, man...visit Maya, or get the recipe...visit Maya, or get the recipe...?

1.0: Hello there. If you're looking for the Chief, he should be in the front of the park entrance.\r\n#L0##bI came to get that recipe for Camila.#l\n#k
1.1: Oh! Okay...but who are you, and where is Camila?\r\n#L0##bCamila went to visit Maya at the hospital. She asked me to come pick up the recipe because...I guess we're kinda friends...#l\n#k
1.2: Oh, how sweet of her. Poor Maya...it's so nice Camila is looking after her.

npc.0: You'll find Mrs. Ming Ming in front of Chief Stan's house. His house is just up the stairs to the left. Can't miss it!
